items.question: Give me the exchange rate to USD for GBP on the effective date of 2026-01-01.

items.question: What is the description in the code lookup table for the department code FIN?

items.question: List the customer ID, sales region, and loyalty tier for every customer in the AP region who holds the Platinum tier (P).

items.question: Show all product names and their list prices for items in the electronics category (ELC) that are marked as discontinued (disc_flag = 1).

items.question: Pull the order ID, order total amount, and currency code for orders placed via the mobile app (APP) during November 2025 (between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-30).
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, currency_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' and '2025-11-30';

items.question: Find the line number, product SKU, and quantity ordered for every line item belonging to order O-5002, sorted by line number ascending.
items.sql: SELECT line_no, sku, qty FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5002' ORDER BY line_no ASC;

items.question: Retrieve the currency code and all available effective dates for EUR in the exchange rate table, ordered by the effective date in descending order.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, eff_dt FROM fx_rate WHERE currency_cd = 'EUR' ORDER BY eff_dt DESC;

items.question: Identify all customers who are currently marked as inactive or closed (is_actv = 0) and belong to the NA sales region. Return their customer IDs and signup dates.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 0 AND region_cd = 'NA';

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price for all products in the home category (HOM) whose list price exceeds 50.00, ordered from highest price to lowest, breaking ties by SKU alphabetically.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'HOM' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Find the order ID, order date, and order total for all USD orders placed in the first quarter of 2026 (from 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-31) that were subsequently cancelled (ord_status = C). Sort by order date ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_status = 'C' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, unit price, and discount percentage for order lines on order O-5001 where a discount was applied (disc_pct > 0), ordered by line number.
items.sql: SELECT sku, unit_prc, disc_pct FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' AND disc_pct > 0 ORDER BY line_no ASC;

items.question: Give me the customer ID and loyalty tier of Gold tier customers (tier_cd = G) in the EU region who signed up before 2022-07-01.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, tier_cd FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'G' AND region_cd = 'EU' AND signup_dt < '2022-07-01';

items.question: List the SKU and list price of kitchen items (categ_cd = KIT) that are still active (not discontinued, disc_flag = 0) and priced under 100.00, sorted by price descending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND disc_flag = 0 AND list_prc < 100.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC;

items.question: Find all exchange rates for USD where the effective date is on or after 2026-01-01, returning the effective date and rate to USD, sorted chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT eff_dt, rate_to_usd FROM fx_rate WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND eff_dt >= '2026-01-01' ORDER BY eff_dt ASC;

items.question: Pull the order ID, order date, and channel code for all Web orders (channel_cd = WEB) that were delivered (ord_status = D) during April 2026 (2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30).
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, channel_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_status = 'D' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30';

items.question: Retrieve the code value and code description from the code lookup table for all entries belonging to the order status code list (ORD_STATUS).
items.sql: SELECT code_val, code_desc FROM code_lookup WHERE code_type = 'ORD_STATUS';

items.question: Identify order lines from order O-5001 where the quantity ordered is greater than or equal to 3, showing the line number, SKU, and quantity.
items.sql: SELECT line_no, sku, qty FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' AND qty >= 3;

items.question: Show the customer ID and signup date for any customer in the Latin America region (LA) who signed up during the third quarter of 2022 (between 2022-07-01 and 2022-09-30).
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd = 'LA' AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-09-30';

items.question: Find all office products (categ_cd = OFC) with a list price between 50.00 and 150.00 inclusive, returning their SKU and product name, sorted by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'OFC' AND list_prc BETWEEN 50.00 AND 150.00 ORDER BY sku ASC;

items.question: Get the order ID, order status, and total amount for orders placed via phone (PHN) whose total amount exceeds 500.00, ordered by order total descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_status, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'PHN' AND ord_total_amt > 500.00 ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC;

items.question: Display the code value and description for all entries under the tier code list in the code lookup table, ordered alphabetically by the stored code.
items.sql: SELECT code_val, code_desc FROM code_lookup WHERE code_type = 'TIER' ORDER BY code_val ASC;

items.question: Can you pull up the details for customer C-1002 from the master record?
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, tier_cd, region_cd, signup_dt, is_actv FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id = 'C-1002'

items.question: Show me the order date, order status, total amount, currency code, and sales channel for order O-5002.
items.sql: SELECT ord_dt, ord_status, ord_total_amt, currency_cd, channel_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_id = 'O-5002'

items.question: What is the full name, department code, direct manager employee ID, and hire date for employee E-002?
items.sql: SELECT emp_nm, dept_cd, mgr_emp_id, hire_dt FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-002'

items.question: Please retrieve the refund request amount, reason code, status code, and request date for refund R-9001.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_amt, reason_cd, status_cd, req_dt FROM refund_req WHERE rfd_id = 'R-9001'

items.question: List all customers who belong to the Platinum loyalty tier, showing their customer ID, name, region code, and signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, region_cd, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P'

items.question: Find all support tickets that are currently unassigned, showing the ticket ID, customer ID, opened timestamp, and severity level.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NULL

items.question: Give me a list of all products in the electronics category, displaying their SKU, product name, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC'

items.question: Show all shipments handled by carrier UPS, returning the shipment ID, order ID, warehouse ID, and ship date.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, wh_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS'

items.question: Which orders have a cancelled status? List their order ID, customer ID, order date, and total amount, ordered by order date ascending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: List all inactive customer records from the master table, returning customer ID, name, region code, and signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, region_cd, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 0

items.question: Display all discontinued products from the catalog, showing the SKU, product name, category code, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, categ_cd, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1

items.question: Find all support tickets opened in the month of April 2026, showing the ticket ID, customer ID, severity level, and category code.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, sev_lvl, categ_cd FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00'

items.question: Can you check which support tickets remain open as of now? Return the ticket ID, customer ID, opened timestamp, and severity level, sorted by severity level ascending then ticket ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, sev_lvl FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL ORDER BY sev_lvl ASC, tkt_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve all refund requests that were submitted between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-30, showing the refund ID, order ID, requested amount, and reason code, ordered by refund amount descending then refund ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt, reason_cd FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC

items.question: Show all payments that failed during processing, displaying the payment attempt ID, order ID, method code, and payment amount, ordered by payment amount descending then payment attempt ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, method_cd, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F' ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id ASC

items.question: List all policy rules that were in force on 2026-02-01, returning the rule ID, rule key, rule value, and effective from date.
items.sql: SELECT rule_id, rule_key, rule_val, eff_from FROM policy_rule WHERE eff_from <= '2026-02-01' AND (eff_to >= '2026-02-01' OR eff_to IS NULL)

items.question: Find all ticket history events where an employee performed a close action, showing the event ID, ticket ID, event timestamp, and actor employee ID, ordered by event timestamp descending then event ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, tkt_id, evt_ts, actor_emp_id FROM tkt_event WHERE evt_type = 'CLOSE' ORDER BY evt_ts DESC, evt_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve all orders placed through the mobile app channel during January 2026, showing the order ID, customer ID, order date, and total amount, ordered by order date ascending then order ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Show all shipments that are currently in transit, returning the shipment ID, order ID, warehouse ID, and ship date, ordered by ship date ascending then shipment ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, wh_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'I' ORDER BY ship_dt ASC, ship_id ASC

items.question: List all refund requests that were denied, showing the refund ID, order ID, requested amount, and decided date, ordered by decided date descending then refund ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, ord_id, rfd_amt, decided_dt FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'D' ORDER BY decided_dt DESC, rfd_id ASC

items.question: Identify all inventory stock records where the on-hand quantity has fallen to or below the reorder point, showing the SKU, warehouse ID, on-hand quantity, and reorder point, ordered by on-hand quantity ascending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, reorder_pt FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt ORDER BY on_hand_qty ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Find all support tickets categorized under billing issues with a critical severity level, showing the ticket ID, customer ID, opened timestamp, and assigned employee ID, ordered by opened timestamp ascending then ticket ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id, opened_ts, assigned_emp_id FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'BILL' AND sev_lvl = 1 ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC

items.question: Retrieve all customer segment history records for the North America region customers who were classified as VIP in November 2025, returning the customer ID, month date, and segment code.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_id, c.month_dt, c.segment_cd FROM cust_segment_hist c JOIN cust_master m ON c.cust_id = m.cust_id WHERE m.region_cd = 'NA' AND c.month_dt = '2025-11-01' AND c.segment_cd = 'VIP'

items.question: List all web clickstream events of type purchase that occurred on 2025-11-01, showing the event ID, session ID, customer ID, and order ID, ordered by event timestamp ascending then event ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT evt_id, session_id, cust_id, ord_id FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'PURCHASE' AND evt_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND evt_ts < '2025-11-02 00:00:00' ORDER BY evt_ts ASC, evt_id ASC

items.question: Pull up the name and region for warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE wh_id = 'W1';

items.question: List every shipment ID and order ID that shipped via DHL.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL';

items.question: Which SKUs are currently flagged as discontinued in the product catalog? List their SKUs and product names.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1;

items.question: Show the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for any inventory record where the stock has dropped to or below the reorder point.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE on_hand_qty <= reorder_pt;

items.question: Retrieve all payment IDs, order IDs, and payment amounts where the status indicates the payment failed.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'F';

items.question: Give me the order IDs and order total amounts for all orders placed through the store channel.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'STR';

items.question: Show the movement IDs, SKUs, and moved quantities for stock movements that were adjustments.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'ADJ';

items.question: Find all shipments that are currently in transit, showing their shipment ID, order ID, and ship date.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE ship_status = 'I';

items.question: List the SKU, warehouse ID, and on-hand quantity for inventory records in warehouse W2 where the on-hand quantity is over 700 units, ordered highest quantity first, then by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND on_hand_qty > 700 ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the order ID, payment attempt ID, and payment amount for any payments settled in USD during the first half of November 2025 (between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-15 inclusive).
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, pay_id, pay_amt FROM payment WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-11-15 23:59:59';

items.question: Display the shipment ID, order ID, and delivery date for all shipments handled by UPS that were delivered in April 2026, sorted by delivery date ascending then shipment ID.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, deliv_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'UPS' AND deliv_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' ORDER BY deliv_dt ASC, ship_id ASC;

items.question: Find all inventory rows for warehouse W3 where the product category code from the catalog is electronic (ELC), returning the SKU and on-hand quantity.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t1.on_hand_qty FROM inventory AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.wh_id = 'W3' AND t2.categ_cd = 'ELC';

items.question: List the movement ID, timestamp, and quantity for all stock movements that caused an outbound shipment linked to order O-5001.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, mv_ts, qty FROM inv_move WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' AND mv_type = 'OUT';

items.question: Pull the order ID, order date, and total amount for web orders placed in 2026 that have a status of delivered, sorted by order date descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_status = 'D' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show the SKU, list price, and product name for all kitchen products that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT sku, list_prc, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND disc_flag = 0;

items.question: List all payment IDs and paid timestamps for payments made via PayPal on order O-5018.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, paid_ts FROM payment WHERE ord_id = 'O-5018' AND method_cd = 'PP';

items.question: Show the shipment ID, warehouse ID, and carrier code for shipments dispatched from Newark Hub (warehouse ID W1) during January 2026, ordered by ship date.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ship_id, t1.wh_id, t1.carrier_cd FROM shipment AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.wh_nm = 'Newark Hub' AND t1.ship_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' ORDER BY t1.ship_dt ASC, t1.ship_id ASC;

items.question: Find all stock movements where the quantity moved was negative outbound stock from the Rotterdam Hub warehouse occurring in October 2025, returning movement ID, SKU, and quantity.
items.sql: SELECT t1.mv_id, t1.sku, t1.qty FROM inv_move AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.wh_nm = 'Rotterdam Hub' AND t1.mv_type = 'OUT' AND t1.qty < 0 AND t1.mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-10-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY t1.mv_ts ASC, t1.mv_id ASC;

items.question: Retrieve the order ID, order total amount, and currency code for orders placed via the mobile app in currency EUR that are either cancelled or returned.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, currency_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND currency_cd = 'EUR' AND ord_status IN ('C', 'R') ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price for products that have a stock movement with positive incoming quantity (restock) at any warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t1.sku, t1.prod_nm, t1.list_prc FROM prod_catalog AS t1 JOIN inv_move AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t2.mv_type = 'IN' AND t2.qty > 0 ORDER BY t1.sku ASC;

items.question: Show the shipment ID, delivery date, and warehouse name for all delivered shipments whose delivery date is missing (NULL) or unassigned.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ship_id, t1.deliv_dt, t2.wh_nm FROM shipment AS t1 JOIN warehouse AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t1.deliv_dt IS NULL ORDER BY t1.ship_id ASC;

items.question: Find the payment ID, order ID, and payment amount for payments where the payment status was refunded after settling, associated with orders fulfilled through the phone channel.
items.sql: SELECT t1.pay_id, t1.ord_id, t1.pay_amt FROM payment AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.pay_status = 'R' AND t2.channel_cd = 'PHN' ORDER BY t1.paid_ts ASC, t1.pay_id ASC;

items.question: List the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and region code for all warehouses that hold inventory for SKU ELC-024 with an on-hand quantity greater than 500.
items.sql: SELECT t1.wh_id, t1.wh_nm, t1.region_cd FROM warehouse AS t1 JOIN inventory AS t2 ON t1.wh_id = t2.wh_id WHERE t2.sku = 'ELC-024' AND t2.on_hand_qty > 500 ORDER BY t1.wh_id ASC;

items.question: Pull the order ID, shipment ID, and carrier code for orders placed in Q2 2026 (between 2026-04-01 and 2026-06-30) that were shipped via Federal Express (FDX).
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t2.ship_id, t2.carrier_cd FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN shipment AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' AND t2.carrier_cd = 'FDX' ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_id ASC;

items.question: Show me the top 3 customers by total order amount in 2026. Return the customer ID, total spent, and their rank.
items.sql: WITH ranked_cust AS (SELECT c.cust_id, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) AS total_spent, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.ord_total_amt) DESC) as rnk FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.cust_id) SELECT cust_id, total_spent, rnk FROM ranked_cust WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY total_spent DESC, cust_id

items.question: Can you rank products by their list price within each category? Show category code, SKU, product name, list price, and the price rank.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) as price_rank FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY categ_cd, price_rank, sku

items.question: Calculate a running total of order amounts placed through the WEB channel during April 2026, ordered by the date and order ID. Show the order date, order ID, order total, and the running total.
items.sql: SELECT ord_dt, ord_id, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: For each order in 2026, show the order ID, order date, order total amount, and the previous order total amount for that same customer using LAG. Sort by customer ID, order date, and order ID.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, LAG(ord_total_amt, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) as prev_ord_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY cust_id, ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: Identify the single most expensive product in each category. Return the category code, SKU, product name, and list price, sorted by category code.
items.sql: WITH ranked_prod AS (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) as rn FROM prod_catalog) SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM ranked_prod WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY categ_cd, sku

items.question: What percentage of the total order revenue in 2026 came from each sales channel? Show the channel code, total channel revenue, and its percentage share of the grand total, ordered by percentage descending.
items.sql: WITH channel_rev AS (SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) as rev FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY channel_cd), total_rev AS (SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt) as grand_rev FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') SELECT cr.channel_cd, cr.rev, (cr.rev / tr.grand_rev) * 100 as pct_share FROM channel_rev cr CROSS JOIN total_rev tr ORDER BY pct_share DESC, cr.channel_cd

items.question: Assign a row number to orders placed on 2026-04-03 ordered by order total descending. Show the order ID, order total amount, and the row number.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id) as row_num FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY row_num, ord_id

items.question: For customer C-1001, list all their orders in 2026 along with the next order date using LEAD. Return the order ID, order date, and the next order date, ordered by order date.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, LEAD(ord_dt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) as next_ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: Find the top 2 highest priced products for each category based on list price. Return category code, product name, and list price, sorted by category code then list price descending.
items.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) as rnk FROM prod_catalog) SELECT categ_cd, prod_nm, list_prc FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 2 ORDER BY categ_cd, list_prc DESC, prod_nm

items.question: Show the cumulative sum of quantities ordered for SKU ELC-026 across all order lines, ordered by order ID and line number. Return order ID, line number, quantity, and the running quantity.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY ord_id, line_no ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_qty FROM ord_line WHERE sku = 'ELC-026' ORDER BY ord_id, line_no

items.question: For each loyalty tier, rank customers by their signup date. Return tier code, customer ID, customer name, signup date, and the rank, ordered by tier code then rank.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tier_cd ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id) as tier_rank FROM cust_master ORDER BY tier_cd, tier_rank, cust_id

items.question: Compare each order's total amount on 2026-04-03 with the previous order amount on that day, using LAG. Return the order ID, order total amount, and previous order amount.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, LAG(ord_total_amt, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) as prev_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_id

items.question: For orders placed in 2026, find each order's line items and compute the line amount (qty * unit_prc). Then add a running total of line amounts per order using a window function. Return order ID, line number, line amount, and the running total.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, (qty * unit_prc) as line_amt, SUM(qty * unit_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id ORDER BY line_no ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_ord_amt FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id IN (SELECT ord_id FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') ORDER BY ord_id, line_no

items.question: Rank customers within each sales region by the total number of orders they placed in 2026. Show region code, customer ID, total orders, and the rank, ordered by region code and rank.
items.sql: WITH cust_orders AS (SELECT c.region_cd, c.cust_id, COUNT(o.ord_id) as ord_cnt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' GROUP BY c.region_cd, c.cust_id) SELECT region_cd, cust_id, ord_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_cd ORDER BY ord_cnt DESC) as region_rank FROM cust_orders ORDER BY region_cd, region_rank, cust_id

items.question: Show the product SKU, list price, and the difference between its list price and the average list price of its category. Return category code, SKU, list price, and price difference, sorted by category code and SKU.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc, list_prc - AVG(list_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd) as diff_from_avg FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY categ_cd, sku

items.question: For all shipments in 2025, calculate the day difference between ship date and delivery date, and assign a row number ordered by this delivery duration descending. Show shipment ID, order ID, and delivery duration.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt) as dur, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(deliv_dt, ship_dt) DESC, ship_id) as rnum FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND ship_dt <= '2025-12-31' AND deliv_dt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rnum, ship_id

items.question: List the top 1 most expensive product for each category. Show category code, SKU, product name, and list price, ordered by category code.
items.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) as rn FROM prod_catalog) SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY categ_cd

items.question: Calculate the percentage contribution of each order's total amount relative to the total sum of all orders on 2026-04-03. Return order ID, order total, and percentage share.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, (ord_total_amt / SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER()) * 100 as pct_of_day FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY pct_of_day DESC, ord_id

items.question: For customers who signed up in 2022, show their customer ID, signup date, and the date of the previous customer signup in the master list using LAG, ordered by signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt, LAG(signup_dt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id) as prev_signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt >= '2022-01-01' AND signup_dt <= '2022-12-31' ORDER BY signup_dt, cust_id

items.question: Assign a dense rank to orders based on their total amount in descending order for the APP channel in 2026. Show order ID, order total amount, and the rank.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id) as amt_rank FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP' AND ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' ORDER BY amt_rank, ord_id

items.question: Show each product's SKU, category code, list price, and the next product's list price within the same category using LEAD, ordered by list price.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, list_prc, LEAD(list_prc, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc, sku) as next_list_prc FROM prod_catalog ORDER BY categ_cd, list_prc, sku

items.question: For each order line of order O-5001, calculate the running total of quantity ordered using a window function. Return order ID, line number, SKU, quantity, and running quantity.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, sku, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (ORDER BY line_no ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_qty FROM ord_line WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001' ORDER BY line_no

items.question: Find the top 3 highest total amount orders for each currency in 2026. Return currency code, order ID, order total amount, and the rank, ordered by currency code and rank.
items.sql: WITH ranked_orders AS (SELECT currency_cd, ord_id, ord_total_amt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC) as rnk FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-12-31') SELECT currency_cd, ord_id, ord_total_amt, rnk FROM ranked_orders WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY currency_cd, rnk, ord_id

items.question: Show all orders placed on 2026-04-03 along with the difference between each order's total amount and the maximum order amount on that day. Return order ID, order total amount, and the difference.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt, ord_total_amt - MAX(ord_total_amt) OVER() as diff_from_max FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_id

items.question: Give me a list of all active platinum tier customers in the North America region. Show the customer ID and name.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm FROM cust_master WHERE tier_cd = 'P' AND region_cd = 'NA' AND is_actv = 1

items.question: List every product in the electronics category. Show the SKU and product name, sorted alphabetically by the product name.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' ORDER BY prod_nm ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Find all support tickets with critical severity opened through the web channel. Return the ticket ID and customer ID.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, cust_id FROM support_tkt WHERE sev_lvl = 1 AND channel_cd = 'WEB'

items.question: Show the count of refund requests grouped by their reason code. Return the reason code and the total request count.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, COUNT(*) FROM refund_req GROUP BY reason_cd

items.question: List the warehouses located in the Asia Pacific region. Return the warehouse ID and warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'AP'

items.question: Show the order ID and order total amount for the five highest value orders placed in July 2026.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-07-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-07-31' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC LIMIT 5

items.question: Rank each customer's orders by their total amount in descending order for customer C-1006. Show the order ID, order date, and the rank.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC) FROM ord_hdr WHERE cust_id = 'C-1006'

items.question: Calculate a running total of refund amounts requested over time in 2025. Show the request date, refund amount, and the running total ordered by request date and refund ID.
items.sql: SELECT req_dt, rfd_amt, SUM(rfd_amt) OVER (ORDER BY req_dt, rfd_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt >= '2025-01-01' AND req_dt <= '2025-12-31'

items.question: For each order, show its order ID, order date, and the order date of the immediately preceding order placed by the same customer using a lag window function.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, LAG(ord_dt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id) FROM ord_hdr

items.question: Find the top 2 highest value orders for every distinct order status. Return the status, order ID, and order total amount.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, ord_id, ord_total_amt FROM (SELECT ord_status, ord_id, ord_total_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ord_status ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC) as rn FROM ord_hdr) t WHERE rn <= 2

items.question: Determine each order line's price relative to the maximum unit price across all order lines in the same order. Show the order ID, line number, unit price, and the max unit price for that order.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, unit_prc, MAX(unit_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id) FROM ord_line

items.question: Assign a dense rank to employees within each department based on their hire date, from oldest to newest. Return the department code, employee name, hire date, and the rank.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, emp_nm, hire_dt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_cd ORDER BY hire_dt ASC, emp_id ASC) FROM emp

items.question: Show each support ticket ID, its opened timestamp, and the timestamp of the next ticket opened in the system using a lead window function.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts, LEAD(opened_ts) OVER (ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC) FROM support_tkt

items.question: Calculate the percentage contribution of each order line's quantity to the total quantity ordered for that specific SKU. Return the order ID, SKU, line quantity, and the percentage.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, sku, qty, (CAST(qty AS DECIMAL(10,4)) / SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY sku)) * 100.0 FROM ord_line

items.question: Find the single most expensive refund request for each reason code. Return the reason code, refund ID, and refund amount, sorted by refund amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM (SELECT reason_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reason_cd ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC) as rn FROM refund_req) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, reason_cd ASC

items.question: For each customer, list their orders ordered by date and compute a cumulative sum of the order total amounts per customer.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, ord_id, ord_dt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM ord_hdr

items.question: Rank the employees in each department by their employee ID using row number. Return the department code, employee ID, and the row number.
items.sql: SELECT dept_cd, emp_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_cd ORDER BY emp_id ASC) FROM emp

items.question: Show the refund request ID, request date, and refund amount, alongside the refund amount of the previous request ordered by request date.
items.sql: SELECT rfd_id, req_dt, rfd_amt, LAG(rfd_amt) OVER (ORDER BY req_dt ASC, rfd_id ASC) FROM refund_req

items.question: Find the top 3 highest value refund requests for each status code. Return the status code, refund request ID, and amount.
items.sql: SELECT status_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt FROM (SELECT status_cd, rfd_id, rfd_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status_cd ORDER BY rfd_amt DESC, rfd_id ASC) as rn FROM refund_req) t WHERE rn <= 3

items.question: Calculate a running total of order amounts by order date for orders placed in USD currency in April 2026, and also include the moving average order amount across the current and preceding two orders using window frames.
items.sql: SELECT ord_dt, ord_id, ord_total_amt, SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), AVG(ord_total_amt) OVER (ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' AND ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' AND ord_dt <= '2026-04-30'

items.question: For each support ticket category, rank tickets by their opened timestamp and show the time gap in hours between each ticket and the chronologically preceding ticket in the same category using LAG.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, tkt_id, opened_ts, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, LAG(opened_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC), opened_ts) FROM support_tkt

items.question: For each customer tier, find the customer who signed up earliest. Return the tier code, customer ID, and signup date.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, signup_dt FROM (SELECT tier_cd, cust_id, signup_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tier_cd ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC) as rn FROM cust_master) t WHERE rn = 1

items.question: For every order line, compute its line value as (qty * unit_prc), then calculate the percentage that each line represents of its parent order's total calculated line value. Return the order ID, line number, line value, and the percentage.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, line_no, (qty * unit_prc), (CAST((qty * unit_prc) AS DECIMAL(12,4)) / SUM(qty * unit_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id)) * 100.0 FROM ord_line

items.question: Identify the employees who have approved refund requests. Using dense rank, rank these employees by the total sum of refund amounts they have approved, in descending order. Return the employee ID, total approved amount, and their rank.
items.sql: SELECT approver_emp_id, SUM(rfd_amt), DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(rfd_amt) DESC, approver_emp_id ASC) FROM refund_req WHERE approver_emp_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY approver_emp_id

items.question: Can you list all warehouse names in the AP sales region?
items.sql: SELECT wh_nm FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd = 'AP' ORDER BY wh_nm

items.question: Show the SKU and on hand quantity for items stored in warehouse W1.
items.sql: SELECT sku, on_hand_qty FROM inventory WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY sku

items.question: What are the distinct carrier codes used in our shipments table?
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT carrier_cd FROM shipment ORDER BY carrier_cd

items.question: Pull up the order ID, payment amount, and currency code for payment attempts made using PayPal.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, pay_amt, currency_cd FROM payment WHERE method_cd = 'PP' ORDER BY pay_id

items.question: Give me the product name and list price for all items in the ELC category that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku

items.question: List the shipment ID, order ID, and shipping date for all shipments handled by DHL.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE carrier_cd = 'DHL' ORDER BY ship_dt, ship_id

items.question: Show each warehouse ID and the total inventory on hand across all its products, sorted by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY wh_id ORDER BY total_on_hand DESC, wh_id

items.question: For orders placed on 2026-01-08, display the order ID, the payment amount, and the running total of payments ordered by the payment timestamp and payment ID.
items.sql: SELECT p.ord_id, p.pay_amt, SUM(p.pay_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ord_id ORDER BY p.paid_ts, p.pay_id) AS running_total FROM payment p JOIN ord_hdr o ON p.ord_id = o.ord_id WHERE o.ord_dt = '2026-01-08' ORDER BY p.ord_id, p.paid_ts, p.pay_id

items.question: I need a list of all inventory movements of type OUT for warehouse W2, showing movement ID, SKU, quantity, and the previous movement quantity in that warehouse ordered by movement timestamp and movement ID.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty, LAG(qty, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id) AS prev_qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W2' AND mv_type = 'OUT' ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id

items.question: Rank the inventory items within each warehouse by their on-hand quantity in descending order, showing warehouse ID, SKU, on hand quantity, and the rank.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC) AS qty_rank FROM inventory ORDER BY wh_id, qty_rank, sku

items.question: Show the product SKU, warehouse ID, and on hand quantity for the item with the highest on hand quantity in each warehouse.
items.sql: SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty FROM (SELECT sku, wh_id, on_hand_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY on_hand_qty DESC) AS rn FROM inventory) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY wh_id

items.question: For payments settled on 2025-11-01, list the payment ID, order ID, payment amount, and the next payment amount in the sequence ordered by timestamp.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, LEAD(pay_amt, 1) OVER (ORDER BY paid_ts, pay_id) AS next_pay_amt FROM payment WHERE pay_status = 'S' AND paid_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND paid_ts < '2025-11-02 00:00:00' ORDER BY paid_ts, pay_id

items.question: Display each carrier code and the count of shipments they handled, ordered from highest to lowest count.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipment GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY shipment_count DESC, carrier_cd

items.question: Find the order ID, channel code, and order total amount for orders that exceed the average order total amount across all orders.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, channel_cd, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_total_amt > (SELECT AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr) ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id

items.question: For each payment method, show the method code, the total payment amount, and its percentage share of the grand total payment amount across all methods.
items.sql: SELECT method_cd, SUM(pay_amt) AS method_total, (SUM(pay_amt) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(pay_amt) FROM payment)) AS pct_of_total FROM payment GROUP BY method_cd ORDER BY method_total DESC, method_cd

items.question: List the top 2 products by list price in each category code, showing category code, product SKU, product name, and list price.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM (SELECT categ_cd, sku, prod_nm, list_prc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY categ_cd ORDER BY list_prc DESC) as rnk FROM prod_catalog) t WHERE rnk <= 2 ORDER BY categ_cd, list_prc DESC, sku

items.question: For each warehouse, show the warehouse ID, the SKU of the inventory item, its on hand quantity, and the running total of on hand quantities ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, sku, on_hand_qty, SUM(on_hand_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY sku ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_wh_qty FROM inventory ORDER BY wh_id, sku

items.question: For shipments in warehouse W1, list the shipment ID, order ID, shipping date, and the previous shipment date for that warehouse using LAG.
items.sql: SELECT ship_id, ord_id, ship_dt, LAG(ship_dt, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY ship_dt, ship_id) AS prev_ship_dt FROM shipment WHERE wh_id = 'W1' ORDER BY ship_dt, ship_id

items.question: Using dense ranking, assign a rank to each order based on its total amount in descending order for each sales channel, and show channel code, order ID, order total amount, and the rank.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, ord_id, ord_total_amt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC) AS amt_rank FROM ord_hdr ORDER BY channel_cd, amt_rank, ord_id

items.question: For each order date in January 2026, show the order date, order ID, order total amount, and the moving average of the order total amount over the current and preceding order on that same date, ordered by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT ord_dt, ord_id, ord_total_amt, AVG(ord_total_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_dt ORDER BY ord_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: Display the payment ID, order ID, payment amount, and the difference between each payment amount and the maximum payment amount for that order.
items.sql: SELECT pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, pay_amt - MAX(pay_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ord_id) AS diff_from_max FROM payment ORDER BY ord_id, pay_id

items.question: For each inventory movement in warehouse W3, list movement ID, SKU, quantity, and compute a cumulative sum of movement quantities ordered by movement timestamp and movement ID.
items.sql: SELECT mv_id, sku, qty, SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wh_id ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_qty FROM inv_move WHERE wh_id = 'W3' ORDER BY mv_ts, mv_id

items.question: Find the top 3 payment attempts by payment amount for each currency code, returning currency code, payment ID, order ID, and payment amount.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt FROM (SELECT currency_cd, pay_id, ord_id, pay_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_cd ORDER BY pay_amt DESC, pay_id) as rn FROM payment) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY currency_cd, pay_amt DESC, pay_id

items.question: For orders placed through the WEB channel, list the order ID, order date, order total amount, and the ratio of that order's total amount to the sum of all WEB channel orders.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt, ord_total_amt / SUM(ord_total_amt) OVER () AS ratio_to_web_total FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' ORDER BY ord_dt, ord_id

items.question: How many active customers do we have in each sales region? Show the region code and the count, ordered by the count descending then region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY cust_count DESC, region_cd ASC;

items.question: Can you get a breakdown of product catalog items by category code? Show the category code and the number of products, sorted by count descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS prod_count FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY prod_count DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Show me the count of orders placed through each sales channel for orders placed on or after 2026-04-01. List the channel code and the total orders, ordered by total orders descending and channel code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(*) AS ord_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY ord_count DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: What is the total order amount across all orders for each order status code? Display the order status code and the sum of total amounts, sorted by the sum descending and status code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_sum FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY total_sum DESC, ord_status ASC;

items.question: Find the average list price of products for each category code. Show the category code and the average price, ordered by the average price descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_price FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY avg_price DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: How many distinct customers have placed orders on or after 2026-04-01? Return just the count of unique customers.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) AS distinct_cust_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-04-01';

items.question: Show the minimum and maximum order total amount for each currency code in the order header table. Return the currency code, minimum amount, and maximum amount, sorted by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, MIN(ord_total_amt) AS min_amt, MAX(ord_total_amt) AS max_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd ASC;

items.question: Give me the count of products in each category that are discontinued (where the discount flag equals 1). Show the category code and the count, ordered by count descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS disc_count FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 1 GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY disc_count DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Which loyalty tiers have more than 1 customer registered? Show the tier code and the customer count, ordered by count descending then tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM cust_master GROUP BY tier_cd HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC, tier_cd ASC;

items.question: List all sales channels that have generated a total order amount exceeding 500.00 in USD currency. Show the channel code and the total amount, ordered by total amount descending then channel code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY channel_cd HAVING SUM(ord_total_amt) > 500.00 ORDER BY total_amt DESC, channel_cd ASC;

items.question: Find the top 3 products by total quantity ordered across all order lines. Show the SKU and the total quantity ordered, sorted by total quantity descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY total_qty DESC, sku ASC LIMIT 3;

items.question: What are the average unit prices for each SKU where the average unit price is greater than 100.00? Show the SKU and the average unit price, ordered by the average price descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, AVG(unit_prc) AS avg_unit_prc FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING AVG(unit_prc) > 100.00 ORDER BY avg_unit_prc DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Show the number of orders and the average order total amount for each customer who has placed at least 1 order. Return the customer ID, order count, and average total amount, ordered by order count descending then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS ord_count, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_total FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY ord_count DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: For each currency code, what is the count of exchange rate records effective on or after 2026-01-01? Show the currency code and the record count, ordered by the count descending then currency code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, COUNT(*) AS rate_count FROM fx_rate WHERE eff_dt >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY rate_count DESC, currency_cd ASC;

items.question: List the categories that have an average list price above 60.00 dollars. Show the category code and the average list price, ordered by average list price descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT categ_cd, AVG(list_prc) AS avg_prc FROM prod_catalog GROUP BY categ_cd HAVING AVG(list_prc) > 60.00 ORDER BY avg_prc DESC, categ_cd ASC;

items.question: How many distinct SKUs were ordered within each order status? Join order lines with order headers to figure this out. Show the order status code and the count of distinct SKUs, ordered by the count descending then order status ascending.
items.sql: SELECT h.ord_status, COUNT(DISTINCT l.sku) AS distinct_skus FROM ord_hdr h JOIN ord_line l ON h.ord_id = l.ord_id GROUP BY h.ord_status ORDER BY distinct_skus DESC, h.ord_status ASC;

items.question: Find customers who belong to regions 'NA' or 'EU' and count how many active versus inactive customers there are per region and tier combination. Show the region code, tier code, and active status count, ordered by region code, tier code, then active status.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, tier_cd, is_actv, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM cust_master WHERE region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') GROUP BY region_cd, tier_cd, is_actv ORDER BY region_cd ASC, tier_cd ASC, is_actv ASC;

items.question: Which products (SKUs) have generated more than 300.00 in total revenue (calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price)? Show the SKU and total revenue, ordered by total revenue descending then SKU ascending.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty * unit_prc) AS total_revenue FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(qty * unit_prc) > 300.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, sku ASC;

items.question: Get the top 2 customer names and their total order spending across all of their orders, considering only customers in the 'NA' sales region. Show the customer name and total spending, sorted by total spending descending then customer name ascending.
items.sql: SELECT c.cust_nm, SUM(h.ord_total_amt) AS total_spent FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE c.region_cd = 'NA' GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.cust_nm ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.cust_nm ASC LIMIT 2;

items.question: For each sales region, what is the maximum order total amount placed through the 'WEB' channel? Show the region code and the maximum order amount, ordered by maximum amount descending then region code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT c.region_cd, MAX(h.ord_total_amt) AS max_web_amt FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id WHERE h.channel_cd = 'WEB' GROUP BY c.region_cd ORDER BY max_web_amt DESC, c.region_cd ASC;

items.question: Calculate the average order line discount percentage for each product category code, considering only order lines where the discount percentage is greater than zero. Show the category code and average discount percentage, ordered by the average discount descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.categ_cd, AVG(l.disc_pct) AS avg_disc FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE l.disc_pct > 0.00 GROUP BY p.categ_cd ORDER BY avg_disc DESC, p.categ_cd ASC;

items.question: Which customers have placed orders with an average total amount greater than 300.00 across their orders? Show the customer ID, number of orders, and average total amount, ordered by average total amount descending then customer ID ascending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS ord_count, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amt FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id HAVING AVG(ord_total_amt) > 300.00 ORDER BY avg_amt DESC, cust_id ASC;

items.question: Find the top 3 product categories by total units ordered in order lines. Show the category code and total units ordered, ordered by total units descending then category code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(l.qty) AS total_units FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON l.sku = p.sku GROUP BY p.categ_cd ORDER BY total_units DESC, p.categ_cd ASC LIMIT 3;

items.question: For each loyalty tier, what is the count of distinct customers who have placed at least one order in the header table? Show the tier code and the count of ordering customers, sorted by the count descending then tier code ascending.
items.sql: SELECT c.tier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_id) AS ordering_cust_count FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr h ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id GROUP BY c.tier_cd ORDER BY ordering_cust_count DESC, c.tier_cd ASC;

items.question: How many active customers are there in the AP sales region?
items.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'AP'

items.question: List the product names and their list prices for items in the ELC category that are still being sold.
items.sql: SELECT prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND disc_flag = 0

items.question: Find the description for the order status code 'D'.
items.sql: SELECT code_desc FROM code_lookup WHERE code_type = 'ORD_STATUS' AND code_val = 'D'

items.question: What is the list price of the product named 'Atlas USB Hub'?
items.sql: SELECT list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE prod_nm = 'Atlas USB Hub'

items.question: Show the count of orders placed through the WEB channel on 2026-04-03.
items.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt = '2026-04-03'

items.question: How many products belong to the KIT category?
items.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT'

items.question: Give me the total order amount for order O-5001.
items.sql: SELECT ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_id = 'O-5001'

items.question: Count how many employees are assigned to the FIN department code.
items.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'FIN'

items.question: List the product names and their unit prices for all line items on order O-5001.
items.sql: SELECT T2.prod_nm, T1.unit_prc FROM ord_line AS T1 JOIN prod_catalog AS T2 ON T1.sku = T2.sku WHERE T1.ord_id = 'O-5001'

items.question: What are the names of customers who placed orders on 2026-04-03?
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.cust_nm FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.ord_dt = '2026-04-03'

items.question: Show the order ID and the translated status description for orders placed on 2026-04-03, ordered by order ID.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T2.code_desc FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN code_lookup AS T2 ON T1.ord_status = T2.code_val WHERE T2.code_type = 'ORD_STATUS' AND T1.ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY T1.ord_id

items.question: List the customer names and their loyalty tier descriptions for customers in the NA region.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T2.code_desc FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN code_lookup AS T2 ON T1.tier_cd = T2.code_val WHERE T2.code_type = 'TIER' AND T1.region_cd = 'NA'

items.question: Show the product name and the supplier name for products supplied by supplier ID 1.
items.sql: SELECT T1.prod_nm, T2.sup_nm FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T3 ON T1.sku = T3.sku JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T3.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T3.sup_id = 1

items.question: Find the total quantity ordered for each SKU across all order lines, ordered by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, sum(qty) FROM ord_line GROUP BY sku ORDER BY sku

items.question: Show the promotion name and the count of orders that used each promotion, sorted by promotion ID.
items.sql: SELECT T2.promo_nm, count(T1.ord_id) FROM ord_promo AS T1 JOIN promo AS T2 ON T1.promo_id = T2.promo_id GROUP BY T2.promo_id, T2.promo_nm ORDER BY T2.promo_id

items.question: What is the average order total amount for orders placed by customers in the G loyalty tier?
items.sql: SELECT avg(T1.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr AS T1 JOIN cust_master AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id WHERE T2.tier_cd = 'G'

items.question: Show the customer name, order date, and order total amount converted to USD using the 2026-01-01 exchange rate, for orders placed on 2026-01-08.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T2.ord_dt, T2.ord_total_amt * T3.rate_to_usd FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN fx_rate AS T3 ON T2.currency_cd = T3.currency_cd WHERE T2.ord_dt = '2026-01-08' AND T3.eff_dt = '2026-01-01'

items.question: List the customer name, order ID, product name, and ordered quantity for all items on orders placed on 2026-07-27, ordered by order ID and SKU.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T2.ord_id, T4.prod_nm, T3.qty FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN ord_line AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id JOIN prod_catalog AS T4 ON T3.sku = T4.sku WHERE T2.ord_dt = '2026-07-27' ORDER BY T2.ord_id, T4.sku

items.question: For orders placed in the EUR currency, show the order ID, the payment method code, and the payment amount converted to USD using the effective exchange rate for 2026-01-01, where the payment attempt was settled.
items.sql: SELECT T1.ord_id, T1.method_cd, T1.pay_amt * T2.rate_to_usd FROM payment AS T1 JOIN fx_rate AS T2 ON T1.currency_cd = T2.currency_cd WHERE T1.currency_cd = 'EUR' AND T1.pay_status = 'S' AND T2.eff_dt = '2026-01-01'

items.question: Show the product name, the main supplier's name, and the lead days for all products in the OFC category.
items.sql: SELECT T1.prod_nm, T2.sup_nm, T3.lead_days FROM prod_catalog AS T1 JOIN prod_supplier AS T3 ON T1.sku = T3.sku JOIN supplier AS T2 ON T3.sup_id = T2.sup_id WHERE T1.categ_cd = 'OFC' AND T3.is_primary = 1

items.question: Find the customer name, order ID, and order status description for all delivered orders placed through the APP channel, ordered by order date.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T2.ord_id, T3.code_desc FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN code_lookup AS T3 ON T2.ord_status = T3.code_val WHERE T3.code_type = 'ORD_STATUS' AND T2.channel_cd = 'APP' AND T2.ord_status = 'D' ORDER BY T2.ord_dt

items.question: Show the promotion name, order ID, customer name, and order total amount for orders that used a promotion and were placed by VIP segment customers in January 2026.
items.sql: SELECT T4.promo_nm, T2.ord_id, T1.cust_nm, T2.ord_total_amt FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN ord_promo AS T3 ON T2.ord_id = T3.ord_id JOIN promo AS T4 ON T3.promo_id = T4.promo_id JOIN cust_segment_hist AS T5 ON T1.cust_id = T5.cust_id WHERE T5.month_dt = '2026-01-01' AND T5.segment_cd = 'VIP'

items.question: List the customer name, support ticket ID, category description, and ticket opening timestamp for tickets opened in April 2026 for customers in the EU region.
items.sql: SELECT T1.cust_nm, T2.tkt_id, T3.code_desc, T2.opened_ts FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN support_tkt AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN code_lookup AS T3 ON T2.categ_cd = T3.code_val WHERE T3.code_type = 'TKT_CATEG' AND T1.region_cd = 'EU' AND T2.opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND T2.opened_ts < '2026-05-01 00:00:00'

items.question: For each sales region, calculate the total revenue in USD for orders placed in 2026 using the 2026-01-01 exchange rate, ordered by region code.
items.sql: SELECT T1.region_cd, sum(T2.ord_total_amt * T3.rate_to_usd) FROM cust_master AS T1 JOIN ord_hdr AS T2 ON T1.cust_id = T2.cust_id JOIN fx_rate AS T3 ON T2.currency_cd = T3.currency_cd WHERE T2.ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND T2.ord_dt <= '2026-12-31' AND T3.eff_dt = '2026-01-01' GROUP BY T1.region_cd ORDER BY T1.region_cd

items.question: Show the order status and the number of orders in that status for all orders placed on 2026-04-03.
items.sql: SELECT ord_status, COUNT(ord_id) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03' GROUP BY ord_status ORDER BY ord_status;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and list price for all products in the electronics category whose list price is above 50.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc DESC, sku;

items.question: Show the channel code and count of orders for each sales channel on 2026-04-04.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(ord_id) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-04' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd;

items.question: List the customer name, loyalty tier code, and sales region code for all active customers in the North America region.
items.sql: SELECT cust_nm, tier_cd, region_cd FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND region_cd = 'NA' ORDER BY cust_nm;

items.question: Show the currency code and count of orders for each currency used on 2026-01-08.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, COUNT(ord_id) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-01-08' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and category code for all kitchen products that are not discontinued.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, categ_cd FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'KIT' AND disc_flag = 0 ORDER BY prod_nm;

items.question: Show the region code and the number of active customers in each region.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(cust_id) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd;

items.question: List the order ID, order date, and total amount for orders placed through the website channel on 2026-07-27.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt = '2026-07-27' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id;

items.question: Show the customer ID and the total order amount across all orders for each customer who placed an order on 2026-04-29, avoiding any row duplication from line items.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, SUM(t1.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr t1 WHERE t1.ord_dt = '2026-04-29' GROUP BY t1.cust_id ORDER BY t1.cust_id;

items.question: List the SKU, product name, and total quantity ordered across all order lines for the product with SKU ELC-026.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, SUM(t1.qty) FROM ord_line t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku WHERE t1.sku = 'ELC-026' GROUP BY t1.sku, t2.prod_nm;

items.question: Show the order ID and the count of distinct payment attempts for every order that had multiple payment attempts recorded.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, COUNT(pay_id) FROM payment GROUP BY ord_id HAVING COUNT(pay_id) > 1 ORDER BY ord_id;

items.question: For orders placed on 2026-02-23, show the order ID and the total sum of line item quantities, making sure the join to order lines doesn't misstate other metrics.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, SUM(t2.qty) FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN ord_line t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt = '2026-02-23' GROUP BY t1.ord_id ORDER BY t1.ord_id;

items.question: List each loyalty tier code and the average order total amount for orders placed by customers in that tier during April 2026.
items.sql: SELECT t2.tier_cd, AVG(t1.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN cust_master t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY t2.tier_cd ORDER BY t2.tier_cd;

items.question: Show the customer ID, customer name, and total count of orders for active customers who have placed at least one order.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY t1.cust_id;

items.question: List the carrier code and the number of distinct orders shipped for each carrier during November 2025.
items.sql: SELECT carrier_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) FROM shipment WHERE ship_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY carrier_cd ORDER BY carrier_cd;

items.question: Show the order ID, order total amount, and total payment amount for all orders placed on 2026-01-08, aggregating payments first to avoid row multiplication.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt, SUM(t2.pay_amt) FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN payment t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt = '2026-01-08' GROUP BY t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt ORDER BY t1.ord_id;

items.question: For orders placed in July 2026, list the order ID, order total, and sum of all payment amounts, properly pre-aggregating payments to prevent inflated totals.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt, COALESCE(SUM(t2.pay_amt), 0) FROM ord_hdr t1 LEFT JOIN payment t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt ORDER BY t1.ord_id;

items.question: Show the channel code, count of distinct orders, and total sum of order amounts for all orders in April 2026, avoiding any duplication from order lines.
items.sql: SELECT channel_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id), SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY channel_cd;

items.question: List the customer ID, customer name, and sum of order amounts converted to USD for all orders placed by gold tier customers in 2026, joining fx rates correctly without multiplying order rows.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt * t3.rate_to_usd) FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN fx_rate t3 ON t2.currency_cd = t3.currency_cd AND t2.ord_dt = t3.eff_dt WHERE t1.tier_cd = 'G' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY t1.cust_id;

items.question: For orders placed on 2026-07-23, show the order ID, the count of order lines, and the count of shipments, using subqueries or distinct counts to prevent Cartesian product inflation.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_line l WHERE l.ord_id = t1.ord_id), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment s WHERE s.ord_id = t1.ord_id) FROM ord_hdr t1 WHERE t1.ord_dt = '2026-07-23' ORDER BY t1.ord_id;

items.question: List the order ID, order total amount, and the count of distinct applied promotions for orders placed in 2026 that used more than one promotion code.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.promo_id) FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN ord_promo t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.ord_id, t1.ord_total_amt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.promo_id) > 1 ORDER BY t1.ord_id;

items.question: Show the product category code, total quantity sold, and total revenue in order currency for order lines in July 2026, joining product catalog safely.
items.sql: SELECT t2.categ_cd, SUM(t1.qty), SUM(t1.qty * t1.unit_prc * (1 - t1.disc_pct / 100.0)) FROM ord_line t1 JOIN prod_catalog t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN ord_hdr t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY t2.categ_cd ORDER BY t2.categ_cd;

items.question: For all active platinum customers who placed orders in 2026, list the customer ID, customer name, and total USD value of their orders, handling fx rate joining and aggregation cleanly.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm, SUM(t2.ord_total_amt * t3.rate_to_usd) FROM cust_master t1 JOIN ord_hdr t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id JOIN fx_rate t3 ON t2.currency_cd = t3.currency_cd AND t2.ord_dt = t3.eff_dt WHERE t1.is_actv = 1 AND t1.tier_cd = 'P' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id, t1.cust_nm ORDER BY t1.cust_id;

items.question: List the order ID, order date, and sum of payment amounts for all delivered orders in April 2026, ensuring payments are aggregated separately to avoid row multiplication from multiple payment attempts.
items.sql: SELECT t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, SUM(t2.pay_amt) FROM ord_hdr t1 JOIN payment t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_status = 'D' AND t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt ORDER BY t1.ord_id;

items.question: Show the customer id and signup date for everyone who signed up between 2022-04-01 and 2022-06-30, ordered by signup date ascending and customer id descending.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-04-01' AND '2022-06-30' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id DESC

items.question: List the order id and order date for orders placed in the first quarter of 2026, specifically between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31, sorted by order date.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' ORDER BY ord_dt ASC, ord_id ASC

items.question: How many days elapsed between the signup date and 2022-12-31 for customer C-1001? Return the customer id, signup date, and the calculated days.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, signup_dt, DATEDIFF('2022-12-31', signup_dt) FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id = 'C-1001'

items.question: Find the count of orders placed in April 2026, meaning between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-30.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'

items.question: Show all support ticket IDs, opened timestamps, and their age in days relative to the reference date 2026-04-10 for tickets opened on 2026-04-01.
items.sql: SELECT tkt_id, opened_ts, DATEDIFF('2026-04-10', opened_ts) FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND opened_ts < '2026-04-02 00:00:00' ORDER BY opened_ts ASC, tkt_id ASC

items.question: List the customer ID, name, and signup date for active customers who joined during the month of June 2022, ordered by signup date.
items.sql: SELECT cust_id, cust_nm, signup_dt FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-06-01' AND '2022-06-30' ORDER BY signup_dt ASC, cust_id ASC

items.question: Calculate the total order amount for all orders placed in July 2026 (from 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31) that were shipped (status 'S').
items.sql: SELECT SUM(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'S' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'

items.question: Show the average order total amount for orders placed in the first half of 2026, specifically between 2026-01-01 and 2026-06-30, grouped by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, AVG(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY currency_cd ORDER BY currency_cd ASC

items.question: For orders placed in Q2 2026 (between 2026-04-01 and 2026-06-30), list the order ID, order date, and the number of days between the order date and 2026-06-30, sorted by order date descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, ord_dt, DATEDIFF('2026-06-30', ord_dt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' ORDER BY ord_dt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Find the maximum and minimum order total amounts for orders created between 2026-01-01 and 2026-10-31 using the web channel ('WEB').
items.sql: SELECT MAX(ord_total_amt), MIN(ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31'

items.question: List the customer ID and count of orders for customers who signed up in 2022 (between 2022-01-01 and 2022-12-31) and placed at least one order between 2026-01-01 and 2026-10-31, ordered by order count descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, COUNT(t2.ord_id) FROM cust_master AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.cust_id = t2.cust_id WHERE t1.signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY t1.cust_id ORDER BY COUNT(t2.ord_id) DESC, t1.cust_id ASC

items.question: For each loyalty tier, calculate the average customer signup age in days calculated against the fixed date 2026-10-31, for customers who signed up in 2022 between 2022-01-01 and 2022-12-31.
items.sql: SELECT tier_cd, AVG(DATEDIFF('2026-10-31', signup_dt)) FROM cust_master WHERE signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY tier_cd ORDER BY tier_cd ASC

items.question: Find the SKU, product name, and total quantity ordered across all order lines for orders placed in April 2026 (2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30), sorted by total quantity descending.
items.sql: SELECT t1.sku, t2.prod_nm, SUM(t1.qty) FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN prod_catalog AS t2 ON t1.sku = t2.sku JOIN ord_hdr AS t3 ON t1.ord_id = t3.ord_id WHERE t3.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY t1.sku, t2.prod_nm ORDER BY SUM(t1.qty) DESC, t1.sku ASC

items.question: Show the customer ID, order ID, order date, and payment amount for orders placed in January 2026 (between 2026-01-01 and 2026-01-31) where the payment status was settled ('S').
items.sql: SELECT t1.cust_id, t1.ord_id, t1.ord_dt, t2.pay_amt FROM ord_hdr AS t1 JOIN payment AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t1.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' AND t2.pay_status = 'S' ORDER BY t1.ord_dt ASC, t1.ord_id ASC

items.question: What is the total refund amount requested per reason code for refund requests made during November 2025 (between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-30)? Order by total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT reason_cd, SUM(rfd_amt) FROM refund_req WHERE req_dt BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY reason_cd ORDER BY SUM(rfd_amt) DESC, reason_cd ASC

items.question: List the SKU and total units moved for stock movements of type 'IN' that occurred between 2025-10-01 and 2025-12-31, grouped by SKU.
items.sql: SELECT sku, SUM(qty) FROM inv_move WHERE mv_type = 'IN' AND mv_ts BETWEEN '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the currency code and exchange rate to USD for rates effective on 2026-01-01, ordered by currency code.
items.sql: SELECT currency_cd, rate_to_usd FROM fx_rate WHERE eff_dt = '2026-01-01' ORDER BY currency_cd ASC

items.question: Find the count of distinct customers who had web site viewing events ('VIEW') between 2025-11-01 and 2025-11-30 using the channel 'WEB'.
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM web_event WHERE evt_type = 'VIEW' AND channel_cd = 'WEB' AND evt_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND '2025-11-30 23:59:59'

items.question: List each region code and the number of active customers who signed up between 2022-01-01 and 2022-12-31.
items.sql: SELECT region_cd, COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND signup_dt BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY region_cd ORDER BY region_cd ASC

items.question: For orders placed on 2026-04-03, list the order ID, customer ID, order date, and order total amount, sorted by order total amount descending.
items.sql: SELECT ord_id, cust_id, ord_dt, ord_total_amt FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt = '2026-04-03' ORDER BY ord_total_amt DESC, ord_id ASC

items.question: Calculate the average discount percentage applied on order lines for orders placed between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-30.
items.sql: SELECT AVG(t1.disc_pct) FROM ord_line AS t1 JOIN ord_hdr AS t2 ON t1.ord_id = t2.ord_id WHERE t2.ord_dt BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'

items.question: Find the SKU, product name, and list price for products in category 'ELC' with a list price greater than 50.00, ordered by list price.
items.sql: SELECT sku, prod_nm, list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE categ_cd = 'ELC' AND list_prc > 50.00 ORDER BY list_prc ASC, sku ASC

items.question: Show the count of support tickets opened each day during the week of 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-07, ordered by date.
items.sql: SELECT DATE(opened_ts), COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts BETWEEN '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-04-07 23:59:59' GROUP BY DATE(opened_ts) ORDER BY DATE(opened_ts) ASC

items.question: List the warehouse ID, warehouse name, and region code for warehouses serving the 'NA' or 'EU' regions, ordered by region and warehouse name.
items.sql: SELECT wh_id, wh_nm, region_cd FROM warehouse WHERE region_cd IN ('NA', 'EU') ORDER BY region_cd ASC, wh_nm ASC

items.question: Give me a breakdown of order totals by month for 2026, showing the month and the sum of ord_total_amt in chronological order.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: Can you list the total count of orders placed each month across all channels for the year 2025, starting from January?
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: I need to see the average order amount per quarter for 2026. Please show the quarter and the average, ordered chronologically.
items.sql: SELECT QUARTER(ord_dt) AS ord_quarter, AVG(ord_total_amt) AS avg_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY QUARTER(ord_dt) ORDER BY ord_quarter ASC;

items.question: How many customer signups did we get every month in 2025? Display month and count from earliest to latest.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') AS signup_month, COUNT(cust_id) AS signup_count FROM cust_master WHERE YEAR(signup_dt) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(signup_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY signup_month ASC;

items.question: Show me total sales amount grouped by calendar week for orders placed in October 2025, showing the week and sum.
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%u') AS ord_week, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS total_amount FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2025-10-01' AND ord_dt <= '2025-10-31' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%u') ORDER BY ord_week ASC;

items.question: Can you compute the monthly revenue generated specifically through the WEB channel for 2026, grouped by month?
items.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ord_month, SUM(ord_total_amt) AS web_revenue FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'WEB' AND YEAR(ord_dt) = 2026 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ord_month ASC;

items.question: What is the monthly count of shipped orders for the year 2025? Display month and count in date order.
